cwd.description: Cargo workspace root, relative to the Nx workspace root

dryRun.description: Prints each move and makes none, passing --dry-run to cargo upgrade and cargo update, as NX_DRY_RUN=true does

title: Upgrade
description: Moves every dependency requirement of a Cargo workspace to its newest release with cargo upgrade --incompatible allow, then each crates.io requirement on a stable release to the newest prerelease above it with cargo upgrade --package <crate>@<version>, then the lock with cargo update; a prerelease counts where it names no commit build and its line opened after the newest stable line, as cargo upgrade follows prereleases only from a requirement already on one
